name: Reijuu no Seifuku
source:
The protagonist, a man who runs several love hotels encounters a mysterious woman, Hasumi Kosuzu. She claims that in a past life, she was completely devoted to him, offering both her body and soul. Though initially taken aback by her wild story, the protagonist finds himself intrigued by Kosuzu, who seems distinctly different from other women. He agrees to form a master-slave relationship with her, as she desires. As he trains Kosuzu, he discovers a deep satisfaction in connecting with a woman who submits to him.

This sparks an ambition in him—to make women submit to him through his own power. He sets his sights on Souseikan, a famous hotel complex in the city. With a plan in motion, he aims to bring the hotel’s female president and its beautiful staff under his control…
translation:
经营多家情人旅馆的主人公，邂逅了神秘女子莲见小铃。她声称，在前世，她完全奉献给了他，奉献了自己的身体和灵魂。虽然主角最初对她的疯狂故事感到惊讶，但他发现自己对小铃很感兴趣，她看起来与其他女性截然不同。他同意按照她的意愿与她建立主奴关系。当他训练小铃时，他发现与一个屈服于他的女人交往有一种深深的满足感。

这激发了他的野心——通过自己的力量让女人屈服于他。他把目光投向了市内著名的酒店综合体创成馆。他计划将酒店的女总裁和美女员工纳入自己的掌控之中……
